caption: What if all the oceans vanished for just 5 seconds? The ocean holds about 97% of Earth's water, and its average depth is about 3,682 metres, so fish and whales would suddenly be hanging over a canyon more than 3.5 km deep. Five seconds sounds short, but even then a falling whale would only drop roughly 100 to 120 metres, nowhere near the bottom. The deepest point, Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench, is about 10,935 metres down, deep enough to swallow Mount Everest (8,849 m) with about 2 km to spare. Mumbai's Marine Drive would look out over an empty valley. Ocean plankton produce roughly half of the oxygen made on Earth, so we really want it back. When the water returns, every falling fish is simply about 100 m deeper than before. What would YOU look at first? 👇
